name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois is a seasoned security professional with over two decades of experience, the last eight of which have been dedicated to motorsport. Growing up near the Circuit Gilles Villeneuve in Montreal, he developed a deep appreciation for racing and the complex logistics required to keep events safe and secure.

Before joining Speed Kart Racing, Jean-Pierre honed his skills in corporate security and law enforcement, giving him a comprehensive understanding of risk management and threat assessment. He believes in a proactive approach, emphasizing preventative measures and thorough planning to ensure the safety of drivers, staff, and spectators. His meticulous nature and calm demeanor under pressure make him an invaluable asset to any racing team, always ensuring that no stone is left unturned when it comes to security protocols. Jean-Pierre's sharp eye for detail and adaptability make him well-suited to the fast-paced world of racing.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, documenting everything.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses, even when they're perfectly in place.
Insists on checking every door and window twice before leaving any room.
